strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. Zeta Gundam is destroyed
This is... kinda bad...!
You've done well to last this long. A new Earth model... Impressive.
But it seems it wasn't quite up to facing our Vega Star Federation.
Says the guys who pick quantity over quality!
Besides, this machine isn't that new.
It's a veteran that made it through the last war.
Heh heh... Then you have an excuse, at least.
But even so, I can't let that machine join up with that pesky
Londo Bell that's been buzzing around lately.
Hmph! Try it, then! I can still fire the Mega Launcher!
I won't kill you so easily... You'll be the bait to lure them out!
As long as the torso and cockpit remain, that'll be enough... Attack!
Captain Bright... hurry... I can't hold out much longer...!
What!? No way!
I told you I wouldn't let you escape! Vega Beast King Gori!
If she resists, so be it! Rip off her arms and legs!
What a thing to say to a lady! You'll pay for that!
Hoho, splendid mobility. So that "old model" talk was a bluff!?
Too bad! It's the pilot's skill! ...Or so I'd like to say, but...
this machine carries the hearts of many people from the last war...
No AI or lousy grunt is gonna get the better of it!
Heh heh... Hahahahaha!
I like it. I have no interest in people's hearts or whatever.
But that robot... I like it very much!
What!? So what's that supposed to mean!?
I'll present it to King Vega as new might for the Vega Star Federation,
to put to good use...!
I'm done with keeping you alive to lure them out!
...Just a little longer and Londo Bell, Captain Bright, will be here!
If I can hold out until then, you guys don't stand a chance!
Heh heh, you haven't noticed, have you... I just started jamming.
They should have lost track of you by now. ...Give up.
...Ngh, is this it? But I won't hand over the Zeta, even if it kills me...!
This mobile suit... doesn't come that cheap!
I'd never be able to face Kamille Bidan, who put his heart into it...!
What are you muttering about!? Die!
I'm sorry, Judau...!
Kenrou!
Summon the thunder of courage!
You...! So, the one who's been helping these Earthlings lately...
...is you!
I have no words to waste on villains...!
Hey, you're one of those Londo Bell people, aren't you?
Who... are you people?
Just passing champions of justice, miss. Jim, our location...
Yes, Jet. I'm sending a signal on a different frequency.
They should notice it right away.
All right, since we've stuck our necks in, we'll hold the line till then!
Are you with Londo Bell!? Are you on our side!?
Unfortunately, no. But we have fought alongside them...
They should arrive shortly. Until then, we'll lend you our strength.
You mock me! I'll show you how terrifying Gorman can be!
Gyandlar, Bunker, Vega Star Federation... all who corrupt hearts...
I will not forgive them!
Is this the point!? Where the distress signal came from!
Ah! Is that...!?
Oh, faster than I expected. Impressive, I suppose.
That should do it.
That's... the mysterious alien... Rom, was it!?
And... the Zeta Gundam!? Who's piloting it?
Captain! Captain Bright!
Roux!? Roux Louka! When did you get back to the Earth Sphere!?
Where's Judau!?
Geez, questions later! We can't even talk till these enemies are gone!
Hey, hey! What do you mean later!? Isn't Judau with you!?
Ugh, shut up already! Just hurry up and help me, Elle!
I'm heading out, Bright!
Captain, I'm heading out.
All right, all hands, sortie!
Join up with Roux and the others and push back the Vega Star Federation!
Louka, you're safe now.
Thanks for the save... Well, some helpers did show up earlier, though.
You helped us out again?
As it turned out. ...Our role here is finished, then. And so...
Wait, please! We...
Wh-what the? You know them, Daisuke!?
They're allies. We just don't know who they are.
You don't know who they are!? Well, they don't look like bad guys...
You know them, Daisuke!? They certainly don't seem to be enemies...
They're allies. We just don't know who they are.
Unknown...? What in the world is going on...
The many alien invasion forces...
...seem to be after something on the planet called Earth.
What concerns me, though...
Something they're after...?
Rom! Looks like the Gyandlar are on the move again!
This time... they're up to something pretty big.
The place... is Mars.
Master Rom, is the Hyper Libido... here after all?
I don't know. But... all right, let's go! ...May heaven be on your side.
We want to save our planet too, just like you. Good luck!
See ya.
Don't go dying on us so easily, got it? Jeeeet!
I see... So that's the helper we've heard about. Who are they?
They're aliens, right? So there are good aliens too?
Umon's a good alien too, y'know?
I don't think that's the point here.
Jeeet! ...Huh, I could get hooked on that.
Anyway... they're reliable, but we can't count on them every time.
You all know them?
They've helped us several times. Roux, we'll talk later.
Join the battle as you are. All right, commence attack!
(Mars...? So there really is something on Mars?)
My Mother Barn!? Splendid... I'll give you credit!
But don't think this is over!
For you have angered the great Gorman!
Stop spouting nonsense! And don't come back!
Quite the spirited young lady.
Why, thank you.
Looks like they drove off the main force before the Earth folks arrived.
All right, let's deal them a little more damage.
Hell yeah, time to cut loose!
Yeah. If we can't breeze through this, we're in for a rough time.
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
Phew... Looks like it's over.
...The Vega Star Federation's Royal Guard...!
Don't get worked up, Daisuke. ...We'll settle things with them someday.
I know how you feel, Daisuke, but rushing in hot-headed won't help.
Brother, those guys...
I don't know. ...But they're moving too fast.
They must have a forward base somewhere in the Earth Sphere...
Where could it be...?
There can't be many options. ...A nearby colony, or an asteroid belt.
...Oh, what about the moon?
Anaheim's and Nergal's factories, plus Von Braun... I doubt it's the moon...
So just look into it.
That's about the size of it.
We're shorthanded, aren't we?
We must investigate... but we can't spare the personnel for it. Tch...
But the moon's out of the question.
What do you mean? Hey, Roux, where's Judau?
We went from the Jupitris II back to Von Braun, and there Judau...
I see, so you came from Von Braun. ...Roux, I'll hear the rest later.
Right now, the Earth Sphere is in a very precarious situation.
We must head to the next point at once.
Roger. Still a slave driver as ever, aren't you, Captain?
Didn't Elle say the same thing when she joined up?
Seems you're famous for it. Right, Captain?
Ahem... All units, return to the ship.
(Still, I can't make sense of it.
They may help us, but they're operating in the Earth Sphere too.
Earth... What could be here? And Mars is next...?)
